faqs.aEn: 'XR' stands for Extended-Release dual amino-acid synergy: fast-acting L-Arginine HCl supports immediate nitric oxide synthesis within 30–45 minutes, while L-Citrulline Malate converts progressively into plasma L-Arginine over 4–6 hours for sustained stamina.
